events.summary: Join us in game for the first evening of Next Fest! We'll answer any questions and give you tips on how to rise further up the leaderboard.

events.title: Whimpact! Demo is live for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hi everyone!Whimpact! Demo is out now for Steam Next Fest, and you can play it for free.Grab some friends, pick your Whims, and dive into the co-op chaos. Hit “Download Demo” at the top of the store page to start playing.Watch Us Live:The dev team will be streaming here on Whimpact! Steam page during the Steam Next Fest. events.title: Welcome to Whimpact! ✨
events.summary: Hi everyone!We’re thrilled to finally share Whimpact! with the world. The Whims and their vibrant universe are officially here to welcome you on a multi-player journey. We hope you’ll wishlist the game today and follow us for more updates. Over the next few months, we’ll be sharing game updates and peeks behind-the-scenes, as well as ways you can help shape our continued development.
